title: Profiles not synced between master, NS, NSclient
body:
Im a parent using NSclient on follower phones with full NS sync enabled on master. Today I updated to 3.0.0.1 on both master and NSclient (follower). BG, treatments (bolus, SMB, carbs) sync just fine but my profiles does not seem to sync to and from NS. 
The master is not seeing the NS profiles nor is the local  profiles that I manually had to create in the master being seen in NS or NSclient (follower). 
This means no profile switches or profile changes can be made from NSclient atm.

comments.body: Also I use the latest master on my Nightscout
Solved by deleting old NS profile records in NS.
